## Why

Premise checked 2026-10-28: the bell already ships (ui.notify, adj 44: terminal bell and tab badge). internal/tui/model.go:935-990 rings it when a project's open or held count rises past an earlier reading (Config.Bell, default writes BEL to stderr); docs/dashboard.md:363. Add optional field `Bell *bool` (json `bell,omitempty`; nil means on) to registry.Project and a validator-free accessor; `ork projects set NAME --bell on|off` follows S161's refuse-while-unfinished rule and its plan-changed confirm. 2. In Model.apply, remember each project's set of ended run ids (engine runs with a terminal state and ledger board runs with state ended); the first reading after startup or a setup state is a baseline and rings nothing; a run id seen ending after the baseline rings once. 3. Skip every bell for a project whose Bell is false (counts and badges still update). 4.
